body: cmd/emilyos/main.go: 'emilyos audit bundle [outpath]' produces tar.gz with audit.jsonl + policy-snapshot.json + manifest.json (SHA-256 per file, chain_ok, build info). Default: soc2-evidence.tar.gz. Exit 3 on chain failure. Completes Milestone 5 core requirement.
title: S50-02: emilyos audit bundle — tar.gz SOC 2 evidence bundle (Milestone 5 partial)
